# Squish Toy Guide

> Your ultimate guide to squish toys — expert reviews, sensory scorecards, and buying guides for Needoh and more.

Squish Toy Guide is an independent review site focused on Needoh fidget toys by Schylling. Every product is tested hands-on and scored on five sensory dimensions: Squishiness, Noise, Durability, Stain Risk, and Size.

## Product Reviews

- [Needoh Nice Cube Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/nice-cube): The most popular Needoh toy — squishy cube, 5/5 squishiness, great for desk fidgeting
- [Needoh Gumdrop Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/gumdrop): Super-soft teardrop shape, 5/5 squishiness, best for stress relief
- [Needoh Jellyfish Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/jellyfish): Stretchy tentacles with unique tactile variety, best for sensory play
- [Needoh Ice Cube Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/ice-cube): Firm feel, 5/5 durability, the toughest Needoh toy
- [Needoh Dream Drop Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/dream-drop): Cloud-like super-soft teardrop, 5/5 squishiness
- [Needoh Ice Cream Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/ice-cream): Cute cone shape, super-soft, great gift option
- [Needoh Football Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/football): Firm sporty shape, 5/5 durability, best for stress relief
- [Needoh Advent Calendar Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/advent-calendar): 24 mini Needoh toys, best holiday gift, $25-35
- [Needoh Snowball Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/snowball): Simple round ball, balanced squeeze, budget-friendly
- [Needoh Gummy Bear Review](https://squishtoyguide.com/needoh/gummy-bear): Stretchy candy shape, translucent, fun for sensory play
